prompt.zh-TW: 月光書店的流動比率本來高於一倍。小嵐為了讓數字更漂亮，向銀行借了 {{money:e1.amount}}，半年後要還。這筆交易之後，下面三個數字各會怎麼變？
prompt.en: Moonlight Books’ current ratio was above one. Hoping to make the figure look better, Lan borrows {{money:e1.amount}} from the bank, repayable in six months. After this transaction, how does each of the three figures below change?

explanation.zh-TW: 現金增加 {{money:e1.amount}}，短期借款也增加 {{money:e1.amount}}，分子分母各加同樣的數。當{{term:tm_c8r1t4zm}}原本高於一倍時，兩邊加同樣的數會讓比率往一倍靠近，所以反而下降。流動比率已經高於一倍時，想靠借短期的錢拉高它沒有用；比率低於一倍時，同樣的借款反而會讓它往一倍上升。
explanation.en: Cash rises by {{money:e1.amount}} and short-term borrowings rise by {{money:e1.amount}}, so the same amount is added to numerator and denominator alike. When the {{term:tm_c8r1t4zm}} starts above one, adding the same amount to both sides pulls it towards one, so it falls. When the current ratio is already above one, short-term borrowing will not lift it; when it is below one, the same loan actually moves it up towards one.
